transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I just... I don't really know how to explain it. I just can't stop feeling like everything that goes wrong lately is my fault. Like... I'm just a bad employee, I guess. And a bad homeowner. I just kind of feel like I deserve to lose what I've worked for... so, that's why I came in.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um... it's been a while, I guess. I think... maybe around two years? And, um, a month, give or take. It just kind of... hasn't really gone away.
During these past two years, have you found that you no longer get much pleasure or enjoyment out of the activities you used to like?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I used to do things. Like... plan brunches, or paint in the spare room. Hike, sometimes. I'd even sign up for networking events for work. But... I don't know. Now it just feels like... they're all just tasks I'm pretending to care about. So... yeah.
During these past two years, have there been any periods of two months or longer where you felt like your usual self and didn't have these feelings of low mood or worthlessness?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... maybe a few days here and there where it wasn't as heavy, but... no. It's pretty much been there the whole time.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or eating habits over these past two years?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's just... all over the place. I mostly just... skip meals during the day. I don't really think about it. I've noticed my clothes fit a little looser now. I mostly just... live on coffee, or toast. Just... whatever's easy.
Over these past two years, have you noticed any consistent changes in your sleep patterns, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?

Um... yeah. Sleep is... not great. I just... I lie there for hours. Mostly just listening to the house settle. And then... if I do fall asleep, I'm usually up again around three or four. And I just... I can't get back to sleep before I have to get up for work. So... yeah. It's hard.
Do you often feel like you are not as good as other people or that you are generally inadequate?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It's actually kind of why I'm here. I just... I can't shake this feeling that everything going wrong is my fault. Like... I'm just a bad employee. And a bad homeowner. I just... I feel like I deserve to lose everything I've worked for.
During these past two years, have you ever felt that life is not worth living or had thoughts about ending your life?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... I feel bad a lot, but... I don't think about doing anything like that. I just... try to get through the day, I guess.

Have you ever experienced a period of at least two weeks where your mood was so low or your lack of interest in activities was so severe that it felt significantly worse than how you have been feeling these past two years?
Um... no. Not really. I mean... it's just always been like this. Just... kind of the same. I don't remember it being worse for a couple of weeks or anything. Just... always bad.
